invariants.rationale: The computed x position for the cursor is a non-negative float (i.e., it is likely a screen or logical coordinate, which commonly does not go negative).
The sum of finite float values should produce a finite float.
The result is calculated from numeric values and should not be NaN.
Adding zero to result yields the same value, ensuring no weird state.
The method performs operations on expected-finite coordinates and should never yield negative infinity.
